title: Hire Nearshore AI Engineers in 48 Hours

compliance.summary: The intro presents GoGloby as an “Applied AI Engineering partner” and uses disallowed “AI-native production” positioning. The page also relies on unsupported hiring-speed and offer claims, and contains client, company-fact, and CTA issues that should not carry into a rewrite.

problems.title: Old Applied AI positioning
problems.issue: The intro describes GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering partner and says it turns engineering into “AI-native production,” rather than using the approved staffing and recruiting positioning.
problems.fix: Replace this positioning with the approved company description and remove the “AI-native production” claim.
problems.subject: GoGloby positioning
problems.page_value: Applied AI Engineering partner; AI-native production
problems.source_value: Staffing and recruiting agency specializing in hiring Data & AI Engineers

locations.quote: GoGloby is an Applied AI Engineering partner that turns engineering into AI-native production.

problems.title: Unsupported 48-hour hiring promise
problems.issue: The headline and process promise a 48-hour hiring or matching timeline, which the company says it does not offer.
problems.fix: Remove the 48-hour promise and use the applicable service timeline only if needed.
problems.subject: Hiring timeline

locations.quote: Hire Nearshore AI Engineers in 48 Hours
Get matched with engineers in 48 hours.

problems.title: Old Intelligence Layer name
problems.issue: “AI Intelligence Layer” is an old product name; the current name is “AI Development Intelligence Layer.”
problems.fix: Remove the old product name or replace it with the current name if the feature is mentioned.
problems.subject: Product name

locations.quote: every engagement comes with the AI Intelligence Layer.

problems.title: Free trial week offer
problems.issue: The page offers a free trial week, which GoGloby does not offer.
problems.subject: Free trial

locations.quote: you can start with a free trial week.

problems.title: Mid-level engineers claim
problems.issue: The page says GoGloby places mid-level engineers, while its nearshore staffing offer is for senior engineers and the Glossary excludes mid-level engineers in staffing.
problems.fix: Remove the mid-level claim and describe the roles in line with the current service.
problems.subject: Staffing seniority

locations.quote: We place mid-level and senior AI engineers

problems.title: Founding year is incorrect
problems.issue: The page says GoGloby was founded in 2019; the Fact Sheet says it was founded in 2021.
problems.fix: Correct the founding year to match the Fact Sheet.
problems.subject: Founding year

problems.title: Sergey experience differs
problems.issue: The page says Sergey Matikaynen has 16+ years of experience; the Fact Sheet says he has spent 17 years building software systems, engineering organizations and production platforms.
problems.fix: Correct or remove the experience figure to match the Fact Sheet.
problems.subject: Sergey Matikaynen experience

locations.quote: has spent 16+ years building engineering teams.

problems.title: Disney is not in Fact Sheet
problems.issue: Disney is presented as a GoGloby client but is not listed in the Fact Sheet.
problems.fix: Remove the client claim unless the company confirms it for the Fact Sheet.
problems.subject: Disney

problems.title: GitLab is not in Fact Sheet
problems.issue: GitLab is presented as a GoGloby client but is not listed in the Fact Sheet.
problems.fix: Remove the client claim unless the company confirms it for the Fact Sheet.
problems.subject: GitLab

problems.title: Benchmark CTA is disallowed
problems.issue: The call to action uses “Benchmark,” which the Glossary says not to use as the main CTA; the staffing CTA is “Get vetted profiles.”
problems.fix: Replace the CTA with the approved staffing call to action.
problems.subject: Call to action
